BiblicalUsage: Charak is scorching, and it appears once, in the proof of the deliverance: upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is the whole miracle in one line: the fire did not even leave a smell.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
